entities.name: LIN-28 (C. elegans)
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt P92186; LIN-28 is a heterochronic regulator controlling stage-specific cell fates and developmental timing.
Annotated to bind mRNA and primary/pre-miRNAs; may negatively regulate primary-miRNA processing and suppress let-7 during larval development.
Annotated localization is cytoplasm and nucleus; cytoplasm is listed as principal localization.
Sequence analysis detects a cold-shock domain (residues 55–118) and a CCHC zinc-finger domain (residues 167–183).
